text:
nora-finance: FYI autopay failed for customer MediZen (acct MZ-912). Invoice INV-2026-042, amount $12,450. Payment provider returned `card_declined` on a virtual card.
payments-bot: [automated] attempt_id=pay_8d2f, status=failed, code=card_declined, network_response="issuer_declined", last4=6013, bin=601100, country=US :warning:
mike-billing: last4 + bin helps. 6011xx looks like a Discover BIN. sometimes virtual cards route weirdly. do we have the full provider message? can we retry once?
nora-finance: pasted provider payload below — shortened.
```
{ "id": "pay_8d2f", "status": "failed", "failure_code": "card_declined", "decline_reason": "insufficient_funds", "network": "discover", "3ds_required": false }
```
kate-cs: customer called support. they said their AP used a corporate virtual card and asked if we can accept a wire. they can send wire same-day but need our instructions.
samops: before wire, try a single retry (no-auth change). if it's a virtual card with dynamic controls it might succeed on retry. i'll queue a one-off retry now.
oliver-payments: do not auto-retry more than once — risk of chargeback on some virtual cards. if retry fails, we should disable autopay for that invoice and send a manual pay link + wire instructions.
payments-bot: retry queued: attempt_id=pay_8d2f-r1, scheduled=2026-11-05T15:12:30Z
nora-finance: retry came back FAILED. provider gave `issuer_restricted` and `instruction: contact_issuer`.
mike-billing: ok, escalate to manual flow. kate, please request the customer's wire rails and ask for expected send date. also confirm PO # and contact for reconciliation.
kate-cs: on it. messaging now to AP: "We received failed charge for INV-2026-042. Can you share bank wire instructions and a remittance contact? If wiring, please include benef name exactly as: Redwood Inference, and include invoice number in reference."
kate-cs: customer replied: "We can wire today. Bank: First Federal Commercial. Account name: Redwood Inference LLC. Routing + acct attached in secure file." they asked for a beneficiary address and SWIFT for urgent routing.
julia-cfo: approved to accept wire and mark invoice as pending-cleared on receipt. also OK to apply a 0.5% wire handling fee if they insist on same-day urgent routing. confirm with customer.
nora-finance: sending canonical wire stanza (please use this to verify with bank):
```
Account name: Redwood Inference LLC
Bank name: First Federal Commercial
Account number: 0123456789
Routing (ACH/ABA): 111000025
SWIFT/BIC: FFCBUS33
Reference: INV-2026-042 / MZ-912
```
mike-billing: kate, ask customer to attach bank confirmation or trace number after they send so we can reconcile immediately. once we see funds post, mark invoice PAID and re-enable their autopay only after confirming new token.
samops: also created a short audit ticket: #PAY-4872 recording retry attempts and decision to accept wire. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PAY-4872
oliver-payments: note — because the BIN shows issuer_restricted we should add a temporary autopay block rule on the account to avoid repeated failures. will set rule now.
payments-bot: ledger note created: ledger_entry=LE-99823, holds: autopay_block=true, note="virtual card BIN 6011xx failing".
kate-cs: customer sent bank confirmation (trace 20261105-FF-33421). scheduled to clear today. i attached the secure file in the payment portal.
nora-finance: thanks. mike, once funds posted, please update invoice status and send receipt + credit memo for wire fee if applied.
mike-billing: will do. provisional next steps:
- wait for funds (treasury to watch today)
- when cleared, post payment against INV-2026-042, add remittance note
- if wire fee applies, invoice a short fee: WF-2026-042
- follow up with AP to rotate card token and confirm new default method
julia-cfo: good plan. ensure GL tags for wire fees go to "bank-fees" and not revenue.
nora-finance: marking thread resolved for finance ops, keeping in case of reconciliation questions. :white_check_mark:
kate-cs: customer confirmed funds posted at 18:23Z. attaching bank confirm. thanks all.
mike-billing: posted payment at 18:36Z, invoice now PAID, applied $62.25 wire fee (0.5%). sent receipt and remittance email to AP. closing.
payments-bot: [automated] invoice INV-2026-042 status=paid, payment_id=wire_33421, posted_at=2026-11-05T18:36:10Z
nora-finance: awesome — can we add a short note to the account warning about virtual card BINs and advise AP to use corporate card on file or ACH next time.
mike-billing: added account note and set autopay to disabled_until=2027-01-01 and asked AP to re-authorize.
julia-cfo: thanks team. carry on. :clap:
